description: Adds/removes/updates a step's ignore or match regions, with every regionOp's ids/rects read against the BASELINE or CHECKPOINT image/DOM per `target` (mapped onto whichever side the step's current resolution actually needs). Does not itself change accept/reject. Propagates by default (see propagate) since masking confirmed-dynamic content applies regardless of a sibling's own accept/reject verdict. Returns one entry per touched step, each listing the regions actually changed by each input regionOp (a clear op is reported as the concrete regions it removed). A low-level primitive: for a driven review that also resolves what it finds, use eyes_review_progress with mode: "resolve" instead — it calls this deterministically from its own findings. Call this directly only for a one-off manual fix outside that review.

propagate.description: Which other steps also get this exact change, applied together in the same tool call. Omitted (default): every other step of this session, plus every step of every other session sharing this session's exact scenario name (its other browsers/OS/viewports) — narrowed to the steps that actually apply before anything is sent. "none": only this step — opt out of the default. Any other string: an additional regex tested against every session's scenario name, e.g. "Login|Checkout" — sessions matching are included in the candidate pool on top of the same-scenario default.

regionOps.description: A compact match-region change: (+|-)<matchLevel>-(<rect>|<id>). matchLevel, strictest to loosest: strict (near pixel-perfect), ignorecolors (color-only drift tolerated), layout (content may change but structure must still hold — a vanished/overlapping/resized element is still flagged), ignore (nothing in the region is ever checked). Always pick the strictest level that still accommodates the diff: prefer layout over ignore. A dynamic add is refused — dynamic is the default match level — so add layout instead. Target is a raw rect "left,top,width,height" or a bare DOM node id from eyes_inspect_dom/eyes_inspect_dom_diff. A removal target may also be a glob: "-*" removes every region, "-<matchLevel>-*" removes every region of that one category. Examples: "+layout-14", "-ignore-100,200,50,80", "-layout-*".

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps

target.description: Which side every regionOp's ids/rects are read against. "baseline": the BASELINE image/DOM. "checkpoint": the CHECKPOINT image/DOM instead.

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_resolve_regions
